generation.prompt: Create ONE high-resolution portrait contact sheet, 2 columns by 2 rows, four clean equally-sized borderless photographic panels, no captions or writing. These are original AI demonstration photographs for a fictional unbranded women's apparel catalog. Use the provided beige shirt photo as garment visual guidance. All four panels show the SAME adult female model with dark brown shoulder-length hair wearing the SAME oatmeal beige overshirt: textured woven fabric, long sleeves down to wrist, pointed collar, two symmetrical rectangular chest flap pockets each with a brown button, centered brown button placket, relaxed silhouette, rounded hem. White straight-leg trousers. Top left: front-facing full torso to thigh studio catalog photograph, arms relaxed, show collar, pockets and hem completely. Top right: close-up from neck to hip focusing on both pockets, buttons, weave, cuff; no face needed. Bottom left: three-quarter view torso to thigh, same shirt clearly visible and sleeves extended, hands anatomically natural. Bottom right: relaxed front torso-to-thigh lifestyle photograph against a warm ivory wall with soft window shadows, no furniture obscuring garment. Match premium minimal ecommerce aesthetics: warm ivory, beige, natural neutral white balance, diffused daylight, realistic tactile fabric, clear seams, balanced framing and generous margin. Garment structural details and beige color identical across the four photos. NO logos, NO branding, NO text, NO decorative border, NO extra limbs, NO surreal elements. Arrange exactly four images filling the 2x2 contact sheet.

renderer.encoding: JPEG quality 95, 4:4:4; thumbnails WebP quality 85 width 360

source_preparation: Four generated photo panels extracted without retouching; 32px side padding gives 3:4. Existing AI reference shirt normalized with contain, no stretching. AI example text logo is deterministic typography.
